label: Tutorial: My account
description: Steps of the Tutorial button on the My account page (endpoint account.index). A step: target (CSS selector, empty = centred card), title, text (blank line = new paragraph, **bold**, `code`), roles (optional: anonymous, user, member, admin, perm:<key>), demo (rule / bundle: example shown when the target is missing, e.g. an empty list).

steps.title: Your profile
steps.text: What others see on your public page: avatar, name, links, points and badges. **Edit Profile** changes them.

steps.title: Profile
steps.text: Your details, your API key and your settings.

steps.title: Community
steps.text: People you follow and who follow you. Following someone notifies you of their new rules and bundles.

steps.title: Comments
steps.text: Every comment you wrote, with a link to its rule or bundle.

steps.title: API key
steps.text: Your key for the REST API (header `X-API-KEY`): scripts can search, add and download rules as you. Keep it secret; regenerate it if it leaks.
